name: Geyser
description: The Skyverse is a SkyGen based server on minecraft bedrock edition. The Skyverse is polished and while it doesn't have much, it has fun stuff as parkour, dungeons, and more and more minigames coming soon. You can also PvP on the server and it used PvP from the Hive. This server also has a leveling system in it's minigames and there are events that happen every hour on the server. The Skyverse also includes building areas like plots, the server has clans, and you can buy stuff from shops. The Skyverse is always updating and I suggest you to check it out.
